Question: How do I submit an IT helpdesk request?
Answer: Submit a ticket via the ServiceNow portal at it.optiagent.com/helpdesk (accessible via Okta SSO) or email it.help@optiagent.com. For urgent P1 issues call the IT emergency line listed in the Employee Handbook Section 5. See IT_Policy.docx Section 2.3 for SLA response times.

Question: What are the IT helpdesk SLA response times?
Answer: P1 Critical: 15 minutes acknowledge / 4 hours resolve. P2 High: 1 hour / 8 hours. P3 Standard requests: 4 hours / 1 business day. P4 General: 1 business day / 3 business days. See IT_Policy.docx Section 2.3 and IT_Asset_Register.xlsx (SLA Register tab).

Question: How do I request a new software license?
Answer: Submit a Software Request via ServiceNow (IT > Software Request). Include a business justification. IT Security reviews all new tools before procurement. Standard licenses are provisioned within 2 business days. See IT_Policy.docx Section 15.1.

Question: How do I access the company VPN?
Answer: Install the GlobalProtect VPN client from the IT Software Catalog in ServiceNow. Connect using your Okta credentials with MFA. VPN access uses Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) as the primary method. See IT_Runbook.txt Part D for network access details.

Question: What is Zscaler and do I need it?
Answer: Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) filters and secures all internet traffic from company devices. Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) is the zero-trust replacement for VPN for accessing internal applications. Both are automatically configured on company laptops. See IT_Policy.docx Section 10.2.

Question: How do I connect to the office Wi-Fi?
Answer: Connect to the "OAT-Corporate" SSID using your Okta credentials. Personal or unmanaged devices should use the "OAT-Guest" SSID (internet only; no access to internal resources). See IT_Policy.docx Section 10.2.

Question: What is the IT status page?
Answer: The IT Status Page (status.optiagent.com) shows real-time availability of all major OptiAgent services. Subscribe to email or Slack alerts for updates. During incidents the status page is updated every 30 minutes. See IT_Runbook.txt Part A.

Question: How do I report a P1 production outage?
Answer: Post immediately to Slack #incidents with a description of the issue. Create a ServiceNow incident and set Priority to P1. The on-call MIM (Major Incident Manager) will open a Teams bridge within 15 minutes. See IT_Runbook.txt A1.

Question: What happens during a P1 major incident?
Answer: The MIM opens a Teams bridge; resolver groups are paged via PagerDuty; status.optiagent.com is updated every 30 minutes; CFO and CEO are notified if customer-facing outage exceeds 30 minutes. A Post-Incident Review (PIR) is published within 5 business days. See IT_Runbook.txt A1.

Question: What is a Post-Incident Review (PIR)?
Answer: A PIR is a structured document produced within 5 business days of a P1 incident. It covers: timeline
Difficulty: and corrective action items. The template is in ServiceNow KB0001234. See IT_Runbook.txt A1 Step 6.

Question: What are the production change management rules?
Answer: All changes to production require a Change Request in ServiceNow. Types: Standard (pre-approved)
Category: Normal Minor (IT Change Manager + Tech Lead)
Keywords: Emergency (implement first; CAB retrospective within 48 hours). See IT_Policy.docx Section 4 and IT_Runbook.txt B1–B2.

Question: What are the change freeze periods?
Answer: Year-End Freeze: December 15 – January 5 (all Normal Changes frozen). Quarter-End Freeze: last 5 business days of each quarter (Major Changes frozen). Major Product Launch: 72 hours before and after. Audit Period: January 15 – February 28. See IT_Policy.docx Section 4.4.

Question: When does the Change Advisory Board (CAB) meet?
Answer: The CAB meets weekly on Wednesdays at 2:00 PM in all time zones via Microsoft Teams. A quorum of 4 members (VP IT
Department: and relevant stakeholder) is required for approval. See IT_Policy.docx Section 4.3.

Question: Does every production deployment need a CAB approval?
Answer: Standard changes (routine; pre-approved templates) do not need individual CAB approval — the template is pre-approved. Normal Minor changes need IT Change Manager + Tech Lead. Normal Major changes need full CAB. Emergency changes are implemented first and reviewed retrospectively. See IT_Policy.docx Section 4.2.

Question: What is the rollback procedure for a bad deployment?
Answer: For Kubernetes: run kubectl rollout undo deployment/[service] -n production or use ArgoCD to rollback to a previous version. For databases: consult Engineering Director before rolling back destructive migrations. Full procedure in IT_Runbook.txt B4.

Question: How does the on-call rotation work?
Answer: On-call schedules are managed in PagerDuty and published 4 weeks in advance. On-call engineers must be reachable within 15 minutes and have VPN access available. On-call compensation is in the Engineering Compensation Addendum (available from HRBP). See IT_Runbook.txt A1 Step 3.

Question: What log retention periods apply?

Question: What is SBOM and is it required?
Answer: SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) is an inventory of all software components in an application. OptiAgent generates an SBOM for every production container image using Syft and stores it in the artifact registry. See IT_Policy.docx Section 8.3.

Question: What is the disaster recovery RTO for the production platform?
Answer: RTO: 4 hours. RPO: 15 minutes. The platform uses active-active multi-AZ architecture with Route 53 failover; single AZ failures are handled automatically within minutes. See IT_Policy.docx Section 13.1 and IT_Asset_Register.xlsx (SLA Register).

Question: What is the DR procedure for an AWS region failure?
Answer: Invoke the AWS Region Failover Procedure (IT_Runbook.txt E2). Route 53 health-check-based failover automatically re-routes DNS to us-west-2. The DR RDS read replica is promoted manually to primary. ECS services in us-west-2 scale up.

Question: Where are production backups stored?
Answer: RDS: automated backups with 35-day retention; daily snapshots replicated cross-region to us-west-2. S3: versioning + cross-region replication; lifecycle to Glacier after 90 days. Backups use AWS Backup Vault with Object Lock (immutable). See IT_Runbook.txt D3.

Question: How often are DR tests conducted?
Answer: Tier 1 systems (production platform): quarterly automated failover test + annual full DR test. Corporate systems: annual DR table-top exercises. Results are shared with the Board Audit Committee. See IT_Policy.docx Section 13.2.

Question: What is the RTO for Workday (HRIS)?
Answer: 24 hours. Workday is a Tier 2 system. A manual HR process fallback checklist is maintained in SharePoint for payroll and leave emergencies. See IT_Policy.docx Section 13.1.

Question: What does the IT asset lifecycle look like for a laptop?
Answer: Procurement → Receiving & Configuration (imaged; Intune enrolled) → Deployment (issued to employee; Equipment Receipt signed) → In-Use (annual audit; Intune tracking) → Repair/Replacement → End-of-Life (NIST 800-88 data wipe; Certificate of Destruction; retired in ServiceNow and NetSuite). See IT_Policy.docx Section 6.2.

Question: What is the laptop refresh cycle?
Answer: Laptops are refreshed every 3 years (consistent with the 3-year straight-line depreciation schedule). Engineers and power users may request early refresh in year 2 with manager approval. See IT_Policy.docx Section 6.2 and Finance_Policy.docx Section 11.2.

Question: How are end-of-life laptops disposed of?
Answer: Data is wiped using a NIST 800-88 compliant method (DoD 3-pass for HDDs; cryptographic erase for SSDs or physical destruction). A Certificate of Destruction is issued. The asset is retired in ServiceNow and NetSuite. See IT_Policy.docx Section 6.2.

Question: How do you report a lost or stolen laptop?
Answer: Report immediately to IT Helpdesk (it.help@optiagent.com) AND IT Security (security@optiagent.com). IT will trigger a remote wipe via Intune. File a police report if the device was stolen. See Company_Policy.docx Section 9.1.

Question: Can USB drives be used on company laptops?
Answer: USB storage is disabled by default on all company laptops via Intune/Jamf policy. If you need a USB drive for a legitimate business purpose submit a request via ServiceNow. IT Security will provide a company-issued encrypted USB. See Company_Policy.docx Section 2.3.

Question: What endpoint protection software is installed?
Answer: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (EDR) is installed on all managed Windows and macOS devices. CrowdStrike Falcon Enterprise (with MDR) is also deployed on all endpoints. Both are managed via Intune and monitored by the SOC. See IT_Policy.docx Section 11.1 and IT_Asset_Register.xlsx.

Question: What are the OS version requirements for company laptops?
Answer: macOS: current or N-1 (latest major release minus one). Windows: Windows 11 22H2 or later (Windows 10 only by exception). Older OS versions are blocked by Intune Conditional Access policies. See IT_Policy.docx Section 11.1.

Question: How often are laptops patched?
Answer: Critical CVE patches (CVSS ≥ 9.0): within 24 hours via emergency deployment ring. High CVE patches: within 7 days. Monthly Patch Tuesday: within 14 days via staged deployment rings (Pilot → Early Adopter → Broad). See IT_Policy.docx Section 11.2.

Question: What is the IAM solution at OptiAgent?
Answer: Okta is the Identity Provider (IdP) for all enterprise applications. Okta is federated with Microsoft Entra ID for M365 apps. CyberArk manages privileged access. All applications must integrate with Okta SSO where technically feasible. See IT_Policy.docx Section 12.1.

Question: What is SCIM and how is it used?
Answer: SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) is the protocol used to automatically provision and deprovision users between Workday (HRIS) and Okta (IdP). When HR sets a start or termination date in Workday
Category: Okta automatically creates or deactivates accounts. See IT_Runbook.txt C1 and C2.

Question: How quickly is access revoked when someone is terminated?
Answer: For voluntary terminations: access is revoked at 6:00 PM on the last working day (automated Okta deprovisioning via Workday SCIM). For involuntary/immediate terminations: access is revoked within 15 minutes of the HR trigger. See IT_Runbook.txt C2.

Question: What is ISO 27001 and is OptiAgent certified?
Answer: OptiAgent is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Information Security Management System). Annual certification audits are conducted by BSI Group. All 93 Annex A controls are implemented. See IT_Policy.docx Section 18.1 and Company_Policy.docx Section 3.1.

Question: How often is a penetration test conducted?
Answer: Annual full-scope penetration test by a CREST-accredited third party. Critical and High findings must be remediated within SLAs (24 hours for Critical in production). Results are reviewed by CISO and CTO. See IT_Policy.docx Section 18.2.

Question: What data residency rules apply to EU employee data?
Answer: EU and UK employee personal data must be stored in AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland) or eu-west-2 (London). Transfer outside the EU/UK requires Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). See IT_Policy.docx Section 16.2.

Question: What data residency rules apply to India data?
Answer: Data subject to the India Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023) must be stored in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai). See IT_Policy.docx Section 16.2.

Question: What encryption standard is required for Restricted data?
Answer: AES-256 encryption at rest using AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys (CMKs). TLS 1.2 minimum (TLS 1.3 preferred) for data in transit. Privileged admin access requires FIDO2 hardware key. See IT_Policy.docx Section 16.1.

Question: What restrictions apply to AI training data?
Answer: Training data must have documented provenance. PII must be removed or pseudonymized. Customer data requires explicit consent or legal basis. All training datasets tracked in MLflow with data hash and license. Bias/fairness evaluation required before production deployment. See IT_Policy.docx Section 19.3.

Question: What prompt injection testing is required for LLM endpoints?

Category: self-harm). Output filtering tools such as Perspective API or equivalent are required. See IT_Policy.docx Section 19.4.

Question: What is the software supply chain policy?
Answer: All packages must come from verified registries (npm
Related Document: Maven Central). Private package registries (Artifactory) are used for internal packages. Dependency pinning (exact versions in lock files) is mandatory. SBOM generated for all production containers. See IT_Policy.docx Section 8.3.

Question: What is Trufflehog and where is it used?
Answer: Trufflehog is a secret scanning tool that runs as a pre-commit hook and in the CI pipeline. It detects committed secrets (API keys
Related Document: tokens) before they reach the repository. Any finding blocks the commit or PR. See IT_Policy.docx Section 8.1.

Question: What is Checkov and when does it run?
Answer: Checkov is an Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security scanner for Terraform and CloudFormation. It runs in the CI pipeline and blocks deployment if Critical or High misconfigurations are found (e.g.
Related Document: unencrypted S3 buckets). See IT_Policy.docx Section 8.1.

Question: What is the IaC tool used for infrastructure provisioning?
Answer: Terraform is the primary IaC tool for AWS and GCP resource provisioning. All infrastructure changes must go through Terraform (no manual console changes to production). Terraform state is stored in S3 (versioned; encrypted) with DynamoDB state locking. See IT_Policy.docx Section 8.1.

Question: What is ArgoCD used for?
Answer: ArgoCD is the GitOps continuous deployment tool for Kubernetes. Production deployments are triggered by merging to the production overlay in the GitOps repository. ArgoCD syncs the cluster state to match the Git repository. Rollbacks are performed via ArgoCD. See IT_Runbook.txt B4.

Question: What is PagerDuty used for?
Answer: PagerDuty is the on-call and incident alerting platform. It receives alerts from Datadog
Related Document: and monitoring systems and pages the on-call engineer based on the escalation policy. On-call schedules are published 4 weeks ahead. See IT_Policy.docx Section 3.3.

Category: 5% → 25% → 100% of traffic). Feature flags are also used to disable features during incidents without a full rollback. See IT_Runbook.txt B3.

Question: What is the certificate renewal process?
Answer: Certificates are tracked in ServiceNow with 90-day expiry alerts in Datadog. Let's Encrypt certificates auto-renew via cert-manager in Kubernetes. CA-signed certificates are renewed via DigiCert (IT Security team). See IT_Runbook.txt D4.
